answer: Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a meaningful token bond to register, slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. An attacker wanting to wander in with many fake identities must fund every bond, so forging N agents costs N times the bond plus slashing risk, making it economically irrational. Honest newcomers stake once and build reputation, like a falcon earning trust through consistent flights, while the lagoon of cheap throwaway accounts dries up.
